title: archkeel-mcp — Answer a client’s map request

story.title: archkeel-mcp — Answer a client’s map request

chapters.title: Bind the client to a snapshot

steps.title: Start archkeel-mcp
steps.note: The client launches archkeel-mcp with the repository root and snapshot path printed by Studio.

steps.title: Check the snapshot
steps.note: An overview query verifies the saved repository root before the service accepts requests.

steps.title: Create the MCP server
steps.note: After the check succeeds, the process creates the local MCP server.

steps.title: Register the map tool
steps.note: The map tool accepts a parent, view and optional focus. It uses the same query as the Studio canvas.

steps.title: Listen on standard input
steps.note: The entry point registers the story tools and starts the stdio transport.

steps.title: Return the system map
steps.note: A client calls map. Its registered callback reads the stored hierarchy and returns items, edges, snapshot identity and coverage to the client. The callback dispatch crosses the MCP library.
